title: OpenAPI client definition
description: One file per client, read by the @nx-plugin-openapi/core/plugin Nx plugin. Paths are relative to this file.

name.description: Client name; inferred project names derive from it. Defaults to the directory name.

spec.description: Local OpenAPI spec file, the committed source of truth.

url.description: Remote spec URL. Enables the inferred update-spec target.

headers.description: Request headers for update-spec. Supports ${ENV_VAR} substitution.

format.description: How update-spec writes the downloaded spec.

generator.description: Generator plugin: openapi-tools, hey-api or a custom package name.

generatorOptions.description: Plugin-specific options passed to the generator.

output.description: Generator output directory. Defaults to 'src', or 'generated' when split is configured.

split.description: Split the generated code into types, api and core libs.

targetRoot.description: Directory receiving the types, api and core libs. Defaults to this directory.

tags.description: Tags added to all projects of this client, e.g. scope:shared.
